'''Key to Her Heart''' is a playably voluntary but canonically mandatory storyline mission in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]], accessed independently by [[protagonist]] [[Carl Johnson|Carl "CJ" Johnson]] under the inspiration of blind Chinese-American [[San Fierro Triads]] leader [[Wu Zi Mu|Wu Zi "Woozie" Mu]] from the administrative staff suite of [[The Four Dragons Casino]], located along [[The Strip]] in [[Las Venturas]], [[San Andreas in GTA III Era|San Andreas]].

==Mission==
Carl has just [[Architectural Espionage|returned]] from the [[Las Venturas City Planning Department]] with the blueprints of Caligula's Palace, which he and Woozie intend to burglarize. The next step in his plans involves providing his team access to Caligula's restricted areas by wooing and gaining the trust of one of the casino's croupiers. Eventually, he finds one by the name of [[Millie Perkins]], posing as a master customer Benny, who is killed, after Carl learns she is a prostitute.
 
==Script==
'''CJ''': (''opens a wooden screen of the blueprints of Caligula's Palace'') Now, I know you're blind, man - but you gotta see this.

'''Woozie''': Very clever. So what's the prognosis? Is this just going to be extremely difficult, or next-to-impossible?

'''CJ''': Hear me out on this, homie. Alright, the cash room is on the bottom level. There's a bunch of rooms and a tunnel under the whole building with access to the casino floors at either end of the complex. Alright? Now, security consists of CCTV, a keycode access, and in places, a swipe card.

'''Woozie''': Hey, are you pointing again?

'''CJ''': Oh, my bad - habit.

'''Woozie''': Ah, don't worry; it's good practice for when we finally get a crew in on this.

'''CJ''': Yeah, I know.

'''(''All of a sudden, a Triad member enters the room with a parcel box.'')'''

'''Triad''': Hey boss, this arrived for CJ.

'''CJ''': (''hastily closes the screen'') Hey, hey hey hey! Damn, man - now he's seen the plans!

'''Woozie''': Well, then we've got our first recruit. Come on in and shut the door.

'''CJ''': (''receives the parcel and views its contents'') Alright, cool. This is a security card reader that Zero's sent over. Now all we need to do is get one of those cards... (''outside'') Luckily, there's always one guaranteed weak link in any security set up. The human heart.

'''(''Carl reaches outside the Caligula's Palace Casino, wherein he spots a croupier, [[Millie Perkins]], leaving.'')'''

'''Millie''': (''to herself'') Another shift over!

'''(''Carl then follows her until she reaches a sex shop which he enters. Inside the shop, he finds her trying some threads on with a fellow.'')'''

'''Customer''': Yeah, it's nice and ... tight. I'm sure yours will squeeze in just fine. Let's have a look.

'''Millie''': (''talks on phone to someone as she emerges after putting on her threads'') Oh, hi, Benny. Yeah, I'm trying mine.You got yours? Cool. I'll see you at my house in a short while.

'''(''She exits the shop while Carl acquires a gimp suit, begins trailing her again till she reaches her house, kills the gimp [[Benny (GTA SA)|Benny]] and rings the doorbell.'')'''

'''Millie''': (''from inside'') The door's open, master! (''once both are inside'') Come on in, I'm ready for you.

'''CJ''': You've been a naughty girl.

'''Millie''': Oh right, oh right...

'''CJ''': Spit it out, filthy worm...

'''Millie''': You will never break me!

'''CJ''': If you're good I'll punish you more.

'''Millie''': Oh, Benny, you minx...

'''(''Carl then seduces her and walks out befriending her as the mission ends.'')''' 

==Reward==
The reward for completing the mission is an increase in [[respect]]. The mission [[Dam and Blast]] is unlocked. The player may now also take out Millie Perkins for dates.

==Trivia==
*A [[Love Fist]] poster can be seen when [[Carl Johnson]] and [[Wu Zi Mu]] discuss their plans to rob [[Caligula's Palace]].
*Millie is one of the few GTA characters who actually follows traffic laws, stopping at nearly every red light as you follow her.
